_readme: Contact lookups for bands on the Punk BC board, used by the terminal panel on /ask-a-band.html. Filled in by research, not by the page: a browser can only reach other sites through a CORS proxy, most band and label sites block it, and the pages that do come through are full of things that look like emails but are not -- Bandcamp hands back a Sentry telemetry address that would otherwise be shown as the band's contact. So every entry here is a real lookup someone did, and 'checked' says when.

_fields.band: band name as it appears on the board
_fields.email: best direct address, or empty if none is published
_fields.email_source: where the address came from, so it can be re-verified
_fields.profiles: every place checked, in order: {name, url, found} -- found is 'email' | 'form' | 'profile' | 'none'
_fields.note: anything worth knowing before reaching out
_fields.by: who put this here: 'miki' or a bandmate means a person vouched for it and no crawl may overwrite it; 'auto' means the finder did
